summary: Tested the new driver 'Active Delivery' feature end-to-end. Backend: wrote 18 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_active_delivery.py covering the custody-event stage machine (pickup_confirmed checklist enforcement incl. cold_chain + temperature_controlled cooler rule and 400 messages listing missing items, status->picked_up + picked_up_at; in_transit_ping 400 before pickup, first ping flips picked_up->in_transit, repeat pings append; delivered 400 before pickup, 422 missing recipient_name, 422 'never be left at the door' without evidence, settlement math 42.50/8.50/34.00, earnings row, owed commission ledger entry, driver total_trips increment, no events accepted after delivered; delivery_attempted requires active delivery; returned requires prior attempt, sets status=returned and creates job_returned notifications for facility owner + dispatcher with PUT /notifications/{id}/read working and 404 cross-user), delivery-evidence upload RBAC (422 bad kind, 403 other driver, 403 facility, 201 assigned driver, byte-exact serve for driver/dispatcher/facility/admin, 403 unrelated driver, ?auth= token 200 / bad token 401, 404 unknown id), append-only PUT/DELETE 405, and regressions (legacy /complete from accepted and from in_transit; delivered job reviewable via /reviews/info + POST /reviews and tippable via /tips/checkout). Full backend suite: 156 passed / 0 failed (138 previous + 18 new), incl. test_commission_pivot.py and test_rbac_marketplace.py green. Frontend (mobile 390x844, driver1): full happy path on the cold-chain $42.50 job (accept -> Start Delivery -> Stage 1 full pickup address + Google Maps Navigate link + 3 checkboxes with cooler present, Confirm Pickup disabled until all 3 checked -> Stage 2 dropoff + Navigate + Arrived -> Stage 3 signature canvas drawn with mouse, recipient name, 'other than patient' reveals relationship and re-disables the button until filled -> Delivered summary showing net $34.00) with custody trail verified via API (pickup_confirmed, in_transit_ping, delivered w/ evidence_url + recipient_name/relationship). Exception path on the $58 prescription job (no cooler checkbox, ID tab labelled 'Gov. ID (required option)', setting id-photo-input + name enables Mark Delivered, Customer Unavailable -> Abort dialog -> Return stage with pickup address + Navigate back -> Confirm Return -> 'Item Returned'; job status=returned and both facility1 and dispatcher1 received an unread job_returned notification). Also verified 'Continue Delivery' label + resume-at-Stage-2 for a picked_up job and the automatic 60s ping interval (2 pings recorded in 72s on screen).

integration_issues.issue: The 'arrived' flag is component-local state only. If the driver reloads /delivery/:jobId (or returns from Maps and the tab was evicted) while the job is picked_up/in_transit, the UI drops back to Stage 2 and the driver must tap 'Arrived at dropoff' again. Any typed recipient name / drawn signature is also lost. Consider persisting an 'arrived' marker (custody event or localStorage).
The 60s ping POST failure is swallowed by an empty catch, so repeated failures (offline driver) leave no user-visible signal and no retry/backoff; custody trail would silently have gaps.

issues: Stage progress dots are purely decorative (no labels, no aria/data-testid) so the current stage is only conveyed by the small header badge.
Recipient name / relationship inputs rely on placeholders only — once filled there is no visible label (a11y: no <label>/aria-label on these Inputs).

GPS was denied in the sandbox and every custody event stored gps_lat/gps_lng = null with no UI hint that location capture failed — for a legal chain of custody a 'location unavailable' warning would be valuable.

action_items: Optional: persist the Stage-3 'arrived' state so a page reload does not send the driver back to Stage 2 (and consider preserving recipient name/signature).
Optional: surface in_transit_ping failures (toast/badge) instead of the silent catch, and warn when geolocation is denied since custody GPS ends up null.
Optional a11y: add aria-label/labels to recipient-name and relationship inputs and expose the stage in the progress indicator.
critical_code_review_comments: settle_job_completion refactor is clean and shared by both /complete and the delivered custody event; commission/earnings/total_trips all verified identical between paths.
Stage machine correctly blocks every out-of-order transition tested (no event accepted after delivered/returned) and custody events remain append-only (PUT/PATCH/DELETE 405).
notify_job_return de-dupes targets via a set, so a facility owner who is also the poster gets one notification — verified.
server.py is now ~2700 lines; consider splitting into routers (jobs/custody, payments, admin, drivers) per the >700-line guideline.

Auth is bearer-JWT only: no httpOnly cookie login, no brute-force lockout counters in the codebase (grep for set_cookie/failed_login returns nothing). bcrypt hashes are generated with bcrypt.gensalt() ($2b$). Flagging only as informational — unchanged by this feature.
seed_data_creation: Consumed both seeded LifeLabs Queen West jobs (259d5e65… delivered, 20d3dddd… returned) and RE-SEEDED two equivalent open jobs via facility1: e2238fce-ed1b-4041-bf61-91bf52eecf9c ($42.50 lab_sample cold_chain+fragile+signature_required, temperature_controlled) and 4501864d-9389-46fa-9018-875e7dbc84fb ($58.00 prescription id_required+controlled_substance). Deleted all leftover TEST_QA jobs (incl. two stale $80 ones from earlier iterations). driver1's owed balance grew by commissions on the completed jobs (expected).
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all four accounts valid (login returns access_token, not 'token')
context_for_next_testing_agent: New suite /app/backend/tests/test_active_delivery.py is self-seeding (creates its own facility1 jobs, deletes them via admin in module teardown) — safe to re-run repeatedly; it does NOT touch the two demo open jobs. Login response key is 'access_token'. Driver ledger is GET /api/driver/balance (there is no /driver/ledger); driver total_trips is only visible via GET /api/drivers/{user_id}/record with an admin token. Geolocation is denied in the browser sandbox so all custody events store null GPS — flows still work. Frontend feature flows on /delivery/:jobId (mobile 390x844) were fully verified incl. signature drawing via mouse events and the 60s ping interval (needs a ~72s wait to observe the 2nd ping).
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found in the feature. The only behavioural gap is by design-omission: ActiveDeliveryPage keeps 'arrived' (and signature/recipient inputs) in React state only, so a reload during Stage 3 rewinds the UI to Stage 2; the backend stage machine is unaffected because no custody event is written on 'Arrived'.
